Research
Defining the prognostic and therapeutic role of T cells in hematologic neoplasms utilizing a multi-species comparative approach. Identification and appraisal of novel targets for T cell-based immunotherapy in clinical trials of canine patients with spontaneous and aggressive tumors bearing translational importance for human oncology.
Clinical Specialties:
T cell-based immunotherapy, canine cancer
